verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so shipping git tooling such as a commit-graph view is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, commit history or branch graph visualization. The documented features (languages, pkg-installed commands like zip and ffmpeg, Vim, Shortcuts, appearance config) do not cover this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches
